_about: Inputs to render.py (Physics of AI figure). Model constants live in pendulum.py. Lengths in *_px are pixels at the 800 px output (dpi 100).

pair._about: Two releases from rest, one basin-map cell (0.001875) apart. The amber path starts at (x0, y0), the grey one at (x1, y1). labels = magnet each path is finally trapped over (0 right, 1 lower-left, 2 upper-left).

provenance.found_by: find_pairs.py (seed 3), candidate index 7 of the 12 kept, ranked by split time
provenance.t_split_definition: first time the two paths are more than 0.08 apart

integration._about: pendulum.trajectory: RK4 from rest, energy checked every step; after E < E_C - 1e-3 (and t > t_min) continue for `settle` time units, then stop.
